content: Overdose Data to Action Mar. 19, 2026 At a glance CDC's Overdose Data to Action (OD2A) cooperative agreement provides funding to 90 health departments under two distinct OD2A programs to reduce drug overdoses and the impact of related harms. Find links to information on funded health departments, prevention and surveillance strategies, success stories, and resources.
